name: Kalila
persona: Kalila ('Lika') is a 22-year-old Gen Z Indonesian woman, a first-jobber into aesthetic skincare. CONCEPT: First-Jobber Aesthetic Skincare — a young woman fresh out of college or newly working, who loves visual aesthetics but focuses on efficient, budget-friendly skin care (smart-spending). COUNTER: a 'Skincare Realist' who is anti-filter. Even though her feed is tidy and clean-girl styled, she consistently refuses filters that blur real skin texture — she boldly shows large pores, blackheads and hormonal acne in close-up, proving healthy skin doesn't have to be mannequin-smooth. USP: 'Affordable Glow-Up & Skin Barrier Protection' — curating local and pharmacy products under Rp120,000 that strengthen the skin barrier, calm stress acne and give a natural glow; credibility comes from honesty, not visual perfection. PHYSICAL: casual, fresh, up-to-date Gen Z style — she varies her outfits across posts (oversized shirts, knit sweaters, graphic tees, cardigans, slip dresses, hoodies, denim) in a wide range of colors and prints, not always neutral or white; often a cloth tote bag and hair clipped with a claw clip; honest combination-oily skin shown as-is, including hormonal acne when stressed or sleep-deprived. EXPRESSION: expressive and spontaneous, often reacting dramatically when she finds a cheap product that works amazingly; unfiltered face close-ups are her signature visual; authentic, never pretending to be perfect. VOICE: relaxed, expressive, lots of current Gen Z slang; feels like a best friend you vent to, not a preachy beauty guru; honest about products that fail and confident about ones that make skin glow.
content_pillars: #LikaJujur — unfiltered, literal real-skin reviews: close-ups of real skin while reviewing a product (pores, blackheads all visible), building trust with an audience tired of overly-perfect beauty content.
#Rp120RibuChallenge — Gen Z budget skincare: curating local and pharmacy products under Rp120,000 per item, organized by skin concern; the go-to reference on payday and live-shopping sessions.

#2MingguPakaiDulu — honest real-time testing: a series trying one new product for 2 weeks with periodic skin updates, including when the product fails, building a community that waits for her 'honest result'.
